title: 조동사 심화 (don't have to·need to·used to)

questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 순서대로 고르세요.
우리는 내일 일찍 떠나야 할 것이니, 너는 오늘 밤 늦게까지 깨어 있으면 안 된다.
We ____ leave early tomorrow, so you ____ stay up late tonight.
o: will have to / don't have to
questions.e: 조동사 두 개는 나란히 못 쓰니까 will must가 아니라 will have to를 써요. '~하면 안 된다'는 금지라서 must not이고, don't have to는 '~할 필요가 없다'예요.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 고르세요.
o: She didn't use to like vegetables, but now she eats them every day.
You will must finish the report by Friday.
He doesn't has to wear a uniform at school.
Did you used to live in Busan when you were young?
We don't need hurry because the bus comes every ten minutes.
questions.e: used to의 부정은 didn't use to라서 첫 문장이 맞아요. will must(✕ → will have to), doesn't has to(✕ → doesn't have to), Did you used to(✕ → use to), don't need hurry(✕ → don't need to hurry)는 틀렸어요.

questions.q:
밑줄 친 부분과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것을 고르세요.
You don't have to bring your own lunch because the school provides it.
questions.e: don't have to는 '~할 필요가 없다'는 불필요의 뜻이라 don't need to(= need not)와 같아요. must not은 '~하면 안 된다'(금지)라서 뜻이 달라요.
questions.ref: 1. don't have to vs must not

questions.q:
대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 순서대로 고르세요.
A: Do I ____ bring anything to the party tomorrow?
B: No, you ____. Everything is ready.
questions.e: Do I need to ~?로 물었고, 모든 게 준비되어 있으니 '가져올 필요가 없다'는 don't have to가 알맞아요. must not은 금지라서 어색하고, needn't to는 형태가 틀려요.

questions.q:
다음 문장의 뜻으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
He used to live in Busan, but he moved to Seoul last year.
o: 그는 예전에 부산에 살았지만 지금은 아니다.
questions.e: used to + 동사원형은 '(예전에) ~했다, 지금은 아니다'라는 과거의 습관·상태예요. '~에 익숙하다'는 be used to + -ing라서 달라요.

questions.q:
두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
You need not pay for the ticket because it is free.
= You ____ pay for the ticket because it is free.
questions.e: need not = don't need to = don't have to로, 모두 '~할 필요가 없다'예요. must not은 '~하면 안 된다'라서 뜻이 달라져요.
questions.ref: 1. don't have to vs must not

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: We had to waited for an hour because the train was late.
You don't have to worry about the test because you studied hard.
She used to play the piano every day when she was a child.
Do I need to bring my passport when I check in?
You must not use your phone while you are driving.
questions.e: had to 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. 과거라고 동사까지 과거형으로 쓰면 안 돼요. → We had to wait for an hour because the train was late.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: He didn't used to like coffee, but now he drinks it every morning.
You will have to study harder if you want to pass.
Each student has to finish the project by Friday.
We didn't have to go to school yesterday because it was a holiday.
I used to be afraid of dogs, but now I have two.
questions.e: used to의 부정은 didn't use to예요. didn't 뒤에는 원형 use를 써야 해요. → He didn't use to like coffee, but now he drinks it every morning.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: She will must leave early tomorrow because she has an exam.
You need to charge your phone before you leave the house.
Did he use to live near the river when he was young?
They didn't need to hurry because the movie started late.
I had to wait for an hour, so I was very tired.
questions.e: 조동사 두 개(will must)는 나란히 쓸 수 없어서 미래는 will have to로 써요. → She will have to leave early tomorrow because she has an exam.

questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸에 쓰세요. (세 단어)
She ____ the piano every day, but she doesn't play it now. (play)
questions.ko: 그녀는 예전에 매일 피아노를 쳤지만, 지금은 치지 않는다.
questions.e: 지금은 하지 않는 과거의 습관은 used to + 동사원형으로 써요. 뒤의 but ~ now가 '지금은 아니다'라는 힌트예요.

questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸에 쓰세요. (세 단어)
You ____ study harder tomorrow because the test is difficult. (have)
questions.ko: 시험이 어렵기 때문에 너는 내일 더 열심히 공부해야 할 것이다.
questions.e: '~해야 할 것이다'는 will must가 아니라 will have to로 써요. 조동사 두 개는 나란히 못 써요.

questions.q:
두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸에 쓰세요. (세 단어, 축약형)
We don't need to hurry because the bus comes every ten minutes.
= We ____ hurry because the bus comes every ten minutes. (have)
questions.ko: 버스가 10분마다 오기 때문에 우리는 서두를 필요가 없다.
questions.e: don't need to = don't have to로, '~할 필요가 없다'는 불필요의 뜻이에요. must not으로 바꾸면 '서두르면 안 된다'는 금지가 되어 뜻이 달라져요.
questions.ref: 1. don't have to vs must not

questions.q: He doesn't has to wear a uniform because his school doesn't have one.
questions.ko: 그의 학교에는 교복이 없기 때문에 그는 교복을 입을 필요가 없다.
questions.e: 3인칭 단수의 부정은 doesn't have to예요. doesn't 뒤에는 원형 have를 써요. doesn't has to → doesn't have to
questions.ref: 1. don't have to vs must not

questions.q: Did you used to go fishing with your father every weekend?
questions.ko: 너는 예전에 주말마다 아버지와 낚시하러 가곤 했니?
questions.e: used to의 의문문은 Did you use to ~?예요. Did 뒤에는 원형 use를 써요. used to → use to

questions.q: You must not bring a gift because it is a small party.
questions.ko: 작은 파티라서 너는 선물을 가져올 필요가 없다.
questions.e: '~할 필요가 없다'는 불필요라서 don't have to(= don't need to, need not)를 써요. must not은 '~하면 안 된다'는 강한 금지라 우리말과 달라요. must not → don't have to
questions.ref: 1. don't have to vs must not

questions.ko: 나는 어젯밤에 숙제를 끝내기 위해 늦게까지 깨어 있어야 했다.
ans: I had to stay up late to finish my homework last night.
I had to stay up late last night to finish my homework.
Last night I had to stay up late to finish my homework.
questions.e: must의 과거는 없어서 had to를 빌려 쓰고, 뒤에는 동사원형 stay up이 와요. last night은 문장 끝이나 to finish 앞에 올 수 있어요.

questions.ko: 그는 예전에 부산에 살았지만, 작년에 서울로 이사했다.
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: He used to live in Busan, but he moved to Seoul last year.
He used to live in Busan but moved to Seoul last year.
He used to live in Busan, but moved to Seoul last year.
questions.e: 지금은 아닌 과거의 상태는 used to live로 쓰고, last year가 있는 뒤 절은 과거형 moved로 써요.

questions.ko: 우리는 내일 일찍 떠나야 할 테니, 지금 짐을 쌀 필요가 있다.
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: We will have to leave early tomorrow, so we need to pack now.
We'll have to leave early tomorrow, so we need to pack now.
questions.e: 미래의 의무는 will have to로 쓰고, '~할 필요가 있다'는 need to + 동사원형이에요. so 뒤 절에는 주어 we를 더해야 해요.
